exercises.question: Which sentence uses *como si* with the required mood for a counterfactual comparison?
options: Respondió como si la ironía es una afirmación literal.
Respondió como si la ironía sea una afirmación literal.
Respondió como si la ironía fuera una afirmación literal.

exercises.sentence: Contestó el correo como si nunca ____ leído la aclaración anterior.
exercises.english: He answered the email as if he had never read the previous clarification.
exercises.hint: haber (pluperfect subjunctive auxiliary for an earlier unreal event)

exercises.sentence: Me habló como si no conociera el equívoco que provocó aquel mensaje lleno de sarcasmo.
options: He spoke to me as if he did not know about the misunderstanding caused by that sarcastic message.
He spoke to me because he wanted to explain the misunderstanding caused by that sarcastic message.
He spoke to me as if he had written that sarcastic message himself.
He spoke to me as if there were no sarcasm in the literal message.

exercises.sentence: A veces escribimos como si el sobreentendido ____ evidente para cualquier lector.
exercises.english: Sometimes we write as if the unspoken assumption were obvious to any reader.

exercises.question: Why does the essay mention the four-word message 'Haz lo que quieras'?
options: To show that a phrase with an open literal meaning can carry a connotation of anger without intonation.
To prove that short written replies are always clearer than longer explanations.
To illustrate a phrase that works only in formal office emails between colleagues.

exercises.question: What risk does the essay link to unspoken assumptions (sobreentendidos) in written messages?
options: They make readers ignore the literal grammar of every sentence they read.
A light remark or friendly irony can be received as sarcasm or a curt order.
They guarantee that both speakers share the exact same background context.

exercises.question: What does the essay say writing in a hurry entails?
options: It forces the sender to add too many winks and visual cues to every line.
It prevents anyone from reading a message more than once during the day.
It leaves too many gaps for the other person's imagination to fill in.

prompt.speaker: Meg
prompt.text: Carlos, ¿por qué se molestó tu compañero con tu broma en el grupo de la oficina?

options: Porque no vio el guiño y reaccionó como si mi ironía fuera un comentario literal.
Porque no vio el guiño y reaccionó como si mi ironía es un comentario literal.
Porque no vio el guiño y reaccionó como si mi ironía sea un comentario literal.

exercises.english: He spoke as if he had not understood the irony.

exercises.question: Which word best completes the sentence: 'El ____ nació porque uno hablaba en broma y el otro tomó la frase al pie de la letra'?
options: guiño
equívoco
sarcasmo
